# PDF Studio Bot

Your personal PDF assistant on Telegram. Fast, secure, and multi-language.

## Features

- **Download from URL**: Convert any webpage or document link to PDF instantly.
- **Add Password**: Protect and encrypt your PDF files with a secure password.
- **Remove Password**: Unlock and decrypt password-protected PDFs with the correct password.
- **Split PDF**: Separate multi-page documents into individual PDF pages.
- **Extract PDF**: Specify a start and end page to extract exactly what you need.
- **Rotate PDF**: Rotate your PDF files by 90, 180, or -90 degrees.
- **Merge PDFs**: Combine multiple PDF files (up to 10) into a single document.
- **PDF to Images**: Convert PDF pages into high-resolution PNG images.
- **AI Summary**: Get concise, structured summaries of your PDF documents using Google Gemini AI.
- **Multi-language Support**: Available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
- **PRO Subscription**: Upgrade via Telegram Stars for higher daily limits (up to 50 operations/day).
- **Feedback & Support**: Send feedback, feature suggestions, or issue reports directly to the developer.

## Get Started

- Open the bot on Telegram: [https://t.me/PDFStudio_bot](https://t.me/PDFStudio_bot)
- Website: [https://pdfstudio.gabrielrufino.com/](https://pdfstudio.gabrielrufino.com/)
